questions.text: Decode the T9 mobile keypad cipher [ 7777 - 33 - 777 - 888 - 33 - 777 ]. What is the decoded keyword?

hints.text: Notice that pressing key '7' four times maps to 'S' on a standard phone keypad.
The decoded 6-letter word matches an entry in the 'Cluster Alias' column of Document B.
The word starts with 'S' and ends with 'R'. Find its corresponding physical location in Document B's 4th column.
